title: The advantages of Grafana Kubernetes Monitoring

blocks.content:
Grafana Kubernetes Monitoring provides reactive and proactive advantages.

## Reactive response benefits

Reactive problem solving helps teams respond to issues as they appear. Quick issue identification, alerting, and data correlation shorten troubleshooting time.

### Priority issues at the forefront

The [Kubernetes Overview page](/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/kubernetes-monitoring/triage-your-infrastructure/) surfaces what needs triage in three categories: availability, stability, and infrastructure.

### Real-time alerts

[Real-time alerts](/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/kubernetes-monitoring/respond-to-alerts/) notify you as soon as problems begin. You can jump from alert to runbook, create your own alerts, or copy built-in alerts for customization.

### Logs and metrics correlation

Kubernetes Monitoring uses Loki and Prometheus labels so you can correlate metrics and logs to identify root causes faster.

## Proactive management benefits

Kubernetes Monitoring also supports a proactive strategy and long-term optimization.

### Early error detection

Built-in alerting and historical analysis help detect recurring patterns, spikes, and outliers before they become incidents.

### Cost visibility and management

Cost views show spend across nodes, load balancers, and volumes, and include forecasting features that help you project and manage future costs.

### Resource efficiency management

Resource usage views help you identify overprovisioned and underprovisioned workloads so you can improve scheduling and performance.

### Resource usage forecasts

Prediction views for CPU and memory usage support better planning for scaling and upcoming projects.
